Everything above about "Double The Money" comes from the Virginia Lottery's own published numbers. We only do the counting.
2415.headline: Early stage or late

2416.body:
"Loaded with $2,000s" has 72,628 prizes of $20 still unclaimed, which is its most common win. Just below the top prize is the $500 prize, with 1,185 left. The full count for every prize level is listed below.

Tomorrow's count on "Loaded with $2,000s" will be a little different. The game sells every day, and this page keeps track.

2421.headline: Fewer $577,777 prizes left

2422.body:
Of the unclaimed prize money on "Platinum 7s", about two-thirds is in wins under $2,000. The game is a game with most of its money in small, frequent prizes. That is neither good nor bad, only how it was designed. Choose the kind of game that fits the win you want.

The numbers for "Platinum 7s" will change a little by tomorrow, and this page will change with them.

2426.headline: The prize table, line by line

2427.body:
"HOLIDAY TRIPLER" just reached Virginia stores with 602 top prizes of $300. A new game is the easiest kind to judge. No prizes have been claimed, and the printed odds are accurate for now. Every day of sales changes that, and this page tracks it.

If you play "HOLIDAY TRIPLER" often, bookmark this page. The write-up is updated with each morning's data.
2427.headline: New game, all prizes left

2428.body:
"PEPPERMINT PAYOUT" just went on sale in Virginia. The game has twelve full prize levels with five top prizes of $25,000. Every scratcher starts this way and loses prizes as it sells. You are seeing this one before that starts, when it is easiest to judge.

If you play "PEPPERMINT PAYOUT" often, bookmark this page. The write-up is updated with each morning's data.
2428.headline: New in stores

2429.body:
"MERRY MONEY TREE" is new from the Virginia Lottery. It is a $5 game with four top prizes of $125,000. Nothing big has been won yet because almost no one has played it. This page will show it when that changes.

Every line of MERRY MONEY TREE's prize table below shows today's count, not last month's.
2429.headline: Brand new, no claims yet

2430.body:
"WRAPPED IN RICHES" has joined the Virginia lineup at $10 with three top prizes of $500,000. Only on the first day do the printed odds describe the game exactly, because nothing has been won. Starting tomorrow, this page shows how that changes.

Everything here about "WRAPPED IN RICHES" comes from official Virginia lottery numbers, current through October 31.
